future_check: After any schedule or EXAMPLES_NEEDED change, rerun at least 80 sequential lessons and require lesson_identifiable to accept every one.
rationale: Independent random pairs can be valid yet leave rotation/reflection mappings or prototype lookup underdetermined. A deterministic sample-index schedule makes the materialized lesson, not just individual pairs, identify the intended rule.
summary: Every five-pair lesson uses four demonstrations whose union exposes all transform codes, both index modes, and all palette relations.

future_check: Do not tighten canonical acceptance with generated-only asymmetry constraints; instead verify exact official outputs and keep generated lessons shortcut-resistant.
rationale: The worker contract permits pair-level answer equivalence but forbids ambiguous generated lessons. Canonical inputs therefore use the structural checker, while ordinary generated scenes pass the stronger teaching gate and lesson-level competitor audit.
summary: A single canonical pair may be compatible with more than one operation when prototype symmetry makes all compatible operations produce the same official answer.

future_check: Keep the D4-equivalent-prototypes mutation and the all-selected-transforms-visible witness blocking.
rationale: Symmetric or transform-equivalent shapes can hide a transform code or allow the learner to substitute another prototype. Enumerating D4 orbit representatives makes every selected non-identity operation visible and makes index lookup load-bearing.
summary: Ordinary libraries use connected, fully asymmetric, pairwise D4-inequivalent prototypes.

future_check: Require the strict canonical-profile floor to remain warning-free and the hard census to retain support for n_proto 3, 4, and 5.
rationale: This removes the canonical-profile warning without collapsing hard examples to a fixed template; transform, palette, and lookup complexity remain active and the hard band still covers all declared prototype counts.
summary: One hard-band schedule slot retains the canonical three-prototype width while other hard slots use four or five prototypes.

future_check: After any rule-source edit, require selected exact sync plus execution parity for every distinct archival source.
rationale: The semantic and override defects were in the Python teaching distribution. Rewriting a correct selected Racket rule would create unnecessary source churn, and the archival role is explicitly preserved by the authority audit.
summary: The canonical program and selected task-local target_code remain byte-exact; archival raw_code remains textually different but executes all five canonical pairs.
